class.name: OcgPolyTriangulation
class.brief_description: Provides a triangulation for a surface, a set of surfaces, or more generally a shape.
class.description: ! Provides a triangulation for a surface, a set of surfaces, or more generally a shape. ! ! A triangulation consists of an approximate representation of the actual shape, ! using a collection of points and triangles. ! The points are located on the surface. ! The edges of the triangles connect adjacent points with a straight line that approximates the ! true curve on the surface. ! ! A triangulation comprises: ! - A table of 3D nodes (3D points on the surface). ! - A table of triangles. ! Each triangle (Poly_Triangle object) comprises a triplet of indices in the table of 3D nodes ! specific to the triangulation. ! - An optional table of 2D nodes (2D points), parallel to the table of 3D nodes. ! 2D point are the (u, v) parameters of the corresponding 3D point on the surface approximated ! by the triangulation. ! - An optional table of 3D vectors, parallel to the table of 3D nodes, defining normals to the ! surface at specified 3D point. ! - An optional deflection, which maximizes the distance from a point on the surface to the ! corresponding point on its approximate triangulation. ! ! In many cases, algorithms do not need to work with the exact representation of a surface. ! A triangular representation induces simpler and more robust adjusting, faster performances, and ! the results are as good.

method.name: default
method.description: Constructs an empty triangulation.

method.name: from_2
method.description: Copy constructor for triangulation.

method.name: from_3
method.description: Constructs a triangulation from a set of triangles. The triangulation is initialized with 3D points from Nodes and triangles from Triangles.

method.name: from_4
method.description: Constructs a triangulation from a set of triangles. The triangulation is initialized with 3D points from Nodes, 2D points from UVNodes and triangles from Triangles, where coordinates of a 2D point from UVNodes are the (u, v) parameters of the corresponding 3D point from Nodes on the surface approximated by the constructed triangulation.

method.name: from_5
method.description: Constructs a triangulation from a set of triangles. The triangulation is initialized without a triangle or a node, but capable of containing specified number of nodes and triangles.

method.name: Copy
method.description: Creates full copy of current triangulation

method.name: Deflection_1
method.description: Returns the deflection of this triangulation.

method.name: Deflection_2
method.description: Sets the deflection of this triangulation to theDeflection. See more on deflection in Polygon2D

method.name: Parameters_1
method.description: Returns initial set of parameters used to generate this triangulation.

method.name: Parameters_2
method.description: Updates initial set of parameters used to generate this triangulation.

method.name: Clear
method.description: Clears internal arrays of nodes and all attributes.

method.name: HasGeometry
method.description: Returns TRUE if triangulation has some geometry.

method.name: NbNodes
method.description: Returns the number of nodes for this triangulation.

method.name: NbTriangles
method.description: Returns the number of triangles for this triangulation.

method.name: HasUVNodes
method.description: Returns Standard_True if 2D nodes are associated with 3D nodes for this triangulation.

method.name: HasNormals
method.description: Returns Standard_True if nodal normals are defined.

method.name: Node
method.description: Returns a node at the given index.

method.name: SetNode
method.description: Sets a node coordinates.

method.name: UVNode
method.description: Returns UV-node at the given index.

method.name: SetUVNode
method.description: Sets an UV-node coordinates.

method.name: Triangle
method.description: Returns triangle at the given index.

method.name: SetTriangle
method.description: Sets a triangle.

method.name: Normal_1
method.description: Returns normal at the given index.

method.name: Normal_2
method.description: Returns normal at the given index.

method.name: SetNormal_1
method.description: Changes normal at the given index.

method.name: SetNormal_2
method.description: Changes normal at the given index.

method.name: MeshPurpose
method.description: Returns mesh purpose bits.

method.name: SetMeshPurpose
method.description: Sets mesh purpose bits.

method.name: CachedMinMax
method.description: Returns cached min - max range of triangulation data, which is VOID by default (e.g, no cached information).

method.name: SetCachedMinMax
method.description: Sets a cached min - max range of this triangulation. The bounding box should exactly match actual range of triangulation data without a gap or transformation, or otherwise undefined behavior will be observed. Passing a VOID range invalidates the cache.

method.name: HasCachedMinMax
method.description: Returns TRUE if there is some cached min - max range of this triangulation.

method.name: UpdateCachedMinMax
method.description: Updates cached min - max range of this triangulation with bounding box of nodal data.

method.name: MinMax
method.description: Extends the passed box with bounding box of this triangulation. Uses cached min - max range when available and: - input transformation theTrsf has no rotation part; - theIsAccurate is set to FALSE; - no triangulation data available (e.g. it is deferred and not loaded).

method.name: DumpJson
method.description: Dumps the content of me into the stream

method.name: IsDoublePrecision
method.description: Returns TRUE if node positions are defined with double precision; TRUE by default.

method.name: SetDoublePrecision
method.description: Set if node positions should be defined with double or single precision for 3D and UV nodes. Raises exception if data was already allocated.

method.name: ResizeNodes
method.description: Method resizing internal arrays of nodes (synchronously for all attributes).

method.name: ResizeTriangles
method.description: Method resizing an internal array of triangles.

method.name: AddUVNodes
method.description: If an array for UV coordinates is not allocated yet, do it now.

method.name: RemoveUVNodes
method.description: Deallocates the UV nodes array.

method.name: AddNormals
method.description: If an array for normals is not allocated yet, do it now.

method.name: RemoveNormals
method.description: Deallocates the normals array.

method.name: ComputeNormals
method.description: Compute smooth normals by averaging triangle normals.

method.name: MapNodeArray
method.description: Returns the table of 3D points for read-only access or NULL if nodes array is undefined. Poly_Triangulation::Node() should be used instead when possible. Returned object should not be used after Poly_Triangulation destruction.

method.name: MapTriangleArray
method.description: Returns the triangle array for read-only access or NULL if triangle array is undefined. Poly_Triangulation::Triangle() should be used instead when possible. Returned object should not be used after Poly_Triangulation destruction.

method.name: MapUVNodeArray
method.description: Returns the table of 2D nodes for read-only access or NULL if UV nodes array is undefined. Poly_Triangulation::UVNode() should be used instead when possible. Returned object should not be used after Poly_Triangulation destruction.

method.name: MapNormalArray
method.description: Returns the table of per-vertex normals for read-only access or NULL if normals array is undefined. Poly_Triangulation::Normal() should be used instead when possible. Returned object should not be used after Poly_Triangulation destruction.

method.name: InternalTriangles
method.description: Returns an internal array of triangles. Triangle()/SetTriangle() should be used instead in portable code.

method.name: InternalNodes
method.description: Returns an internal array of nodes. Node()/SetNode() should be used instead in portable code.

method.name: InternalUVNodes
method.description: Returns an internal array of UV nodes. UBNode()/SetUVNode() should be used instead in portable code.

method.name: NbDeferredNodes
method.description: Returns number of deferred nodes that can be loaded using LoadDeferredData(). Note: this is estimated values, which might be different from actually loaded values. Always check triangulation size of actually loaded data in code to avoid out-of-range issues.

method.name: NbDeferredTriangles
method.description: Returns number of deferred triangles that can be loaded using LoadDeferredData(). Note: this is estimated values, which might be different from actually loaded values Always check triangulation size of actually loaded data in code to avoid out-of-range issues.

method.name: HasDeferredData
method.description: Returns TRUE if there is some triangulation data that can be loaded using LoadDeferredData().

method.name: LoadDeferredData
method.description: Loads triangulation data into itself from some deferred storage using specified shared input file system.

method.name: DetachedLoadDeferredData
method.description: Loads triangulation data into new Poly_Triangulation object from some deferred storage using specified shared input file system.

method.name: UnloadDeferredData
method.description: Releases triangulation data if it has connected deferred storage.
